instruction: A candid medium close-up photograph of two children indoors against a wooden wall. On the left, the red-haired boy in a white t-shirt (R2) stands facing right, smiling warmly at the curly-haired girl in a white t-shirt (R1) on the right. The boy has his arm draped over her shoulder, while the girl looks down with a gentle, soft smile. The scene is illuminated by soft, natural light, creating a warm and friendly atmosphere.
